arguments.message:
Sure thing! Since the app was reinstalled, you’ll need to reset and set up two‑factor authentication again:

1. Go to **Settings → Security → Two‑factor authentication**.
2. Choose **Reset**.
3. Follow the normal enrollment flow – scan the new QR code with your authenticator app and enter the fresh six‑digit code to confirm.
4. Save the new recovery codes that are shown (they’re the only way back in if you lose access again).

The old QR code is now invalid, so only the newly scanned one will work.
If you still have a recovery code from the original setup, you can use that to sign in and reset the 2FA from the settings page.
